provenance.source: PR #8119 "fix(tracing): Drop trailing comma when serializing baggage without third-party items", squash-merged 2026-10-28
provenance.note: clean control: Baggage.serialize appended third_party_items even when it was the empty string, so a sentry-only baggage header ended with a comma. The guard is exact because from_incoming_header only ever stores stripped, comma-joined items in that field, so an empty field means there was nothing to append. No later commit touches the statement (git log -L over Baggage.serialize lists only older commits; one later commit touches tracing_utils.py at all) and no revert or fix names the PR.
